name: Fluffear
look: a snow-white bunny in a fluffy ruff, tall ears ending in fluffy earmuff puffs, big purple eyes, a pink nose, pale-blue paws and a blue pom-pom tail
entry: The fluffy puffs on its ears keep out the cold and the noise alike. It burrows into snowdrifts to nap, and only its ear puffs poke out.
how: Evolves into Coateary at level 20, learning Psybeam.
